rules.scheduling: block order, then ordinary/system/unresolved round-robin in reference/occurrence order; this is not execution order
rules.ordinaryReplay: unchanged strict original-header/index guard, full ordered trace and absolute state-diff checks; no inferred boundaries or synthetic merged headers
rules.scope: RPC-enumerated EVM references; completeness of all chain activity, independent engine correctness and all effects remain unproven

comparator.trace: Ordered full call tree, including failed descendants; type/from/to/input/value/gas/gasUsed/output/outcome and ordered per-frame logs including position. Missing optional values differ from zero or empty bytes. Absent calls/logs differ from explicit empty arrays. Provider failure prose is ignored, failure presence is retained.
comparator.normalization: Address and byte-string case, integer representation only. Object property order is irrelevant; all array order is significant. No gas annotation exclusions or log sorting.
comparator.exactReplay: Unsigned legacy type-0 envelope fields must be present and unchanged, with original block hash/index, completed shared header/nonce/isolation checks and strict full trace equality. Each provider must also supply the original transaction pre/post diff and a CallMany diff for exactly the same replay envelope and context. Independently validated complete maps, absolute account/slot values and field presence must match within and across providers, including the sender original nonce and increment; a product validation flag alone is insufficient. Type-1/2 effective-gas-price substitution is incomplete, never exact. This is endpoint agreement using a shared state adapter, not independent-engine or signed-transaction validation.
comparator.stateDiff: Independent schema: exactly pre/post maps, at most 100 distinct accounts and 2000 distinct account/storage-slot pairs across both maps; uint256 balances, uint64 nonces, exact 32-byte slots and values, at most 8 MiB bytecode text. Only balance/nonce/code/storage account fields are accepted. Normalize representation and object order only; reject duplicate normalized keys, unknown fields, accessors and malformed objects. Empty equal maps cannot prove a transaction nonce transition.
comparator.inventory: Candidate balance pairs from all ERC20-shaped receipt Transfer logs; candidate allowances from all ERC20-shaped Approval logs and successful CALL transferFrom/approve/permit arguments. Unknown token candidates remain in the inventory and unavailable. Only the separately listed verified token implementations can be queried. No observed candidates never establishes no effects.
comparator.oracleQueryOrder: Lexicographic balance token:account first, then allowance token:owner:spender; at most eight combined candidates queried, including unsupported candidates in the ordering. No replacements after query failure.
comparator.completeness: All-effects asset and permission inventory completeness remains inconclusive: native fees, NFTs, silent changes, nonstandard permissions, rebases and deferred HyperCore effects are not fully enumerated. Observed-pair corroboration is a separately named metric.

discipline: No retries, fallback methods/endpoints, replacements or invented replay boundaries. Every successful raw response is retained and hashed; arbitrary error bodies are charged/hashed but sanitized. All product outputs are sealed before comparator adjudication.
budgetAccounting: One shared budget covers official enumeration, A/B lists and envelope discovery, product internals and comparator calls. Resolved discovery lookups are charged to the same action RPC cap before any execution. A cap-crossing chunk is charged but never retained as usable evidence.
unassessed: No vendor score, security classification, all-EVM accuracy or independent-engine proof.
